description.value: Quayside Tiki Bar is a tropical-themed bar and restaurant located steps from the Fraser River in New Westminster, serving handcrafted cocktails — including Mai Tais, Blue Lagoon, and Quay Breeze Punch — alongside a wide-ranging menu of sushi, seafood, pizzas, and grilled meats. The venue features a spacious waterfront patio with river views and a lively atmosphere, making it a colourful option for cyclists riding the riverfront. The business appears to have opened recently, with a grand opening event listed on its website.

address.value: 810 Quayside Dr #126, New Westminster, BC V3M 6B9

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 7m; stands (8 spaces, covered) at 88m; stands (10 spaces) at 88m. Total: 18 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at quaysidetiki.com was successfully fetched and confirms the business name, phone (604-777-0401 visible on every page), and address (810 Quayside Dr #126, New Westminster, BC V3M 6B9) — however, the OSM record attributes this business to the community 'North Vancouver', which conflicts with the website's clearly stated New Westminster location. No mention of bike parking, water refill, or washrooms appears anywhere on the website, leaving all required criteria null; the menu does include several vegetarian items (Veggie Pizza, Mixed Greens, Burrata, Caesar Salad) that support a value=true for that optional amenity.
